# `pumpkin-plugins`

> TypeScript plugins, shared tools, and GitHub Actions for Pumpkin Minecraft servers.

Plugins are WebAssembly components that run in Pumpkin's Static Hermes/WASI runtime by default; QuickJS can be selected in the package's build configuration. Source links below return Markdown from the repository; generated API links point to the [documentation site](https://filiphsps.github.io/pumpkin-plugins/). This file is generated from discovered guides, component documentation, package metadata, and API references.

## Getting started

- [Documentation index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/README.md): Catalog of guides and documentation pages.
- [Creating a plugin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/creating-a-plugin.md): This runs the plugin generator (a Turborepo generator, defined in turbo/generators/).
- [Creating an action](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/creating-an-action.md): This runs the action Turborepo generator in turbo/generators/.
- [Documentation site](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/documentation-site.md): The VitePress site combines the hand-written guides in docs/, component READMEs, component-level guides, and generated API references.

## CI and releases

- [Publishing public npm tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/npm-publishing.md): The public npm package set and dependency order are defined in tool-packages.mjs.
- [Trusted publishing for npm tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/npm-trusted-publishing.md): The release workflow publishes the public tools with npm trusted publishing. npm authenticates the GitHub Actions workflow through OpenID Connect (OIDC); no npm write token is…

## Guides

- [Benchmarking QuickJS and Static Hermes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/benchmarking.md): This guide explains what the engine comparison measures, how to read its report, and what conclusions its results support.
- [Creating a VS Code extension](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/creating-an-extension.md): Create an extension package with the Turbo generator.

## Plugin API

- [ABI and runtime support](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/plugin-api/abi-and-runtime.md): The npm package version identifies the TypeScript facade release.
- [API evolution and migration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/plugin-api/api-evolution-and-migration.md): The v0.1.1 @pumpkinmc/pumpkin-api-ts API is the compatibility baseline.
- [Host API areas](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/plugin-api/host-api.md): The pinned pumpkin:plugin@0.1.0 WIT package groups host operations into interfaces for commands, events, server access, worlds, entities, inventory, networking, scheduling, IPC…
- [Lifecycle and registration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/plugin-api/lifecycle-and-registration.md): Extend Plugin, provide metadata(), implement onLoad(context) for startup registration, and optionally implement onUnload(context) to save state and release resources.
- [Setup and build](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/plugin-api/setup-and-build.md): Standalone plugin projects use @pumpkin-plugins/pumpkin-api for the runtime facade and @pumpkin-plugins/build for the pumpkin-plugins-build command.

## Plugin development

- [Building](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/building.md): pumpkin-plugins-build (tools/build) turns a plugin into a .wasm component.
- [Code style](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/code-style.md): pnpm lint runs two linters, and CI runs the same command.
- [Plugin config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/plugin-config.md): Plugins that need settings use @pumpkin-plugins/config (tools/config).
- [Plugin info and READMEs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/plugin-info-and-readmes.md): Each plugin describes itself in one small module that exports info.
- [Testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/testing.md): Each plugin has two vitest projects, set up by definePluginVitestConfig() from @pumpkin-plugins/test-harness/vitest.
- [Turborepo commands](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/turborepo.md): Run direct Turbo tasks through the root pnpm turbo command.

## Repository maintenance

- [Agent tooling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/agent-tooling.md): The repo keeps agent instructions, skills and executable checks separate.
- [CI and releases](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/ci-and-releases.md): Plugin, action, extension and public tool checks are in .github/workflows/ci.yml; the external-consumer matrix is in the reusable .github/workflows/external-consumer.yml.

## Server operations

- [Checking for plugin updates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/plugin-updates.md): Every plugin in this repository checks Pumpkin Market after it loads.
- [Port forwarding](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/port-forwarding.md): Players can only reach a server behind a home router when the router forwards the server's ports.
- [Pumpkin Market API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/docs/pumpkin-market-api.md): This page records the Market API behavior used by this repository's publish action, the Market frontend, and PPM.

## Plugins

- [AppleSkinPumpkin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/apple-skin-pumpkin/docs/index.md): AppleSkin server-side support
- [AppleSkinPumpkin README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/apple-skin-pumpkin/README.md): Additional component overview and usage details.
- [BedrockAddonManager](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/bedrock-addon-manager/docs/index.md): Serves Bedrock packs over HTTP; Pumpkin can't send them to players yet
- [BedrockAddonManager README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/bedrock-addon-manager/README.md): Additional component overview and usage details.
- [BedrockAddonManager: Set up Bedrock packs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/bedrock-addon-manager/docs/setup.md): The folder is scanned at startup and on /baddon reload; new files are not detected automatically.
- [BedrockAddonManager: Troubleshoot Bedrock pack hosting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/bedrock-addon-manager/docs/troubleshooting.md): Check that web.enabled is true, the pack appears in /baddon list, and the configured bind address and port are reachable through the server firewall.
- [Distant Horizons Support Pumpkin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/distant-horizons-support-pumpkin/docs/index.md): Unofficial Distant Horizons server support for Pumpkin
- [Distant Horizons Support Pumpkin README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/distant-horizons-support-pumpkin/README.md): Additional component overview and usage details.
- [Distant Horizons Support Pumpkin: Install and connect](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/distant-horizons-support-pumpkin/docs/setup.md): Before installing, check the plugin README for the supported Distant Horizons release and protocol.
- [Distant Horizons Support Pumpkin: Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/distant-horizons-support-pumpkin/docs/troubleshooting.md): Confirm the client uses the supported Distant Horizons release listed in the plugin README.
- [DynamicLightsPumpkin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/dynamic-lights-pumpkin/docs/index.md): Server-side dynamic lights for held light sources
- [DynamicLightsPumpkin README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/dynamic-lights-pumpkin/README.md): Additional component overview and usage details.
- [DynamicLightsPumpkin: Configure light sources](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/dynamic-lights-pumpkin/docs/configuration.md): Settings live in plugins/data/DynamicLightsPumpkin/config.toml.
- [TabDisplay](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/tab-display/docs/index.md): Customizes Java tab displays with native Bedrock capability gates
- [TabDisplay README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/tab-display/README.md): Additional component overview and usage details.
- [UPnPumpkin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/upnpumpkin/docs/index.md): Opens router ports for Pumpkin with UPnP and NAT-PMP
- [UPnPumpkin README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/upnpumpkin/README.md): Additional component overview and usage details.
- [UPnPumpkin: Troubleshoot port forwarding](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/upnpumpkin/docs/troubleshooting.md): Confirm UPnP or NAT-PMP is enabled in the router settings and that the server host shares the router's local network.
- [Waypoints](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/waypoints/docs/index.md): Server-managed waypoints with access rules and a Java 26.3 HUD
- [Waypoints README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/packages/waypoints/README.md): Additional component overview and usage details.

## GitHub Actions

- [Publish a plugin to Pumpkin Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/actions/publish-to-pumpkin-market/docs/index.md): Upload a released Pumpkin plugin WebAssembly file to its existing Market listing
- [Publish a plugin to Pumpkin Market README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/actions/publish-to-pumpkin-market/README.md): Additional component overview and usage details.
- [Sign PumpkinMC Plugins](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/actions/sign-pumpkin-plugin/docs/index.md): Sign Pumpkin plugin WebAssembly files with their Ed25519 release metadata
- [Sign PumpkinMC Plugins README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/actions/sign-pumpkin-plugin/README.md): Additional component overview and usage details.
- [Update a Pumpkin Market listing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/actions/update-pumpkin-market-listing/docs/index.md): Update Pumpkin Market listing metadata from a JSON file or direct inputs
- [Update a Pumpkin Market listing README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/actions/update-pumpkin-market-listing/README.md): Additional component overview and usage details.
- [Verify Pumpkin plugin signatures](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/actions/verify-pumpkin-plugin/docs/index.md): Verify Pumpkin plugin signatures with optional public-key pinning and metadata checks
- [Verify Pumpkin plugin signatures README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/master/actions/verify-pumpkin-plugin/README.md): Additional component overview and usage details.
